s.note: the shop Uncle Bill sells to Elaine
s.how: Cut 6 slices of rye bread into quarters and toast lightly at 200C for 4 minutes. Top each with folded pastrami from 250g, a little drained sauerkraut from 150g and a square of Swiss cheese from 150g. Bake 5 minutes until melted. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp horseradish and chopped pickle. Dab on each bite and spear with a slice of dill pickle.

s.note: his uncle's Chinese family in New York
s.how: Mix 400g pork mince with a chopped bunch of garlic chives, 1 tbsp grated ginger and 1 tsp sesame oil. Fill 30 dumpling wrappers and pleat. Fry until crisp underneath, add water and steam under a lid for 4 minutes. Serve with black vinegar.

m.note: the hovercraft loose in the streets
m.how: Toss 700g diced pork shoulder in egg and 100g cornflour and fry at 180C until crisp. Simmer chunks of half a pineapple and a red capsicum with 80ml vinegar, 80g sugar and 80ml tomato sauce, then thicken. Toss the pork through and serve with 300g jasmine rice.

w.how: Soak 4 gelatine leaves. Warm 500ml milk with 60g sugar, stir in the gelatine and 1 tsp almond extract. Set in a tray for 3 hours and cut into cubes. Serve in bowls with a tin of lychees and mandarin segments in their syrup.

d.n: Uncle Bill's wedding iced jasmine tea
d.note: the wedding that brings Keung to New York
d.how: Heat 1L water to just off the boil and steep 5 tsp jasmine tea for 4 minutes, then strain and cool. Drain a 565g tin of lychees, keeping the syrup. Stir 150ml of the syrup and the juice of a lime into the tea and chill for an hour. Fill four tall glasses with ice and a few lychees, pour in the tea and finish with a twist of lime peel.
